subject: Gold Skulltula #014
text: At nighttime in the past, a Gold Skulltula sits on the middle pillar of the building being constructed in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: Up on the building being constructed, it sits on the middle pillar.

subject: Gold Skulltula #015
text: At nighttime in the past, a Gold Skulltula is located on the north wall of a house near the entrance to Death Mountain Trail in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Near Death Mountain Trail's entrance, there's a house with a Gold
 Skulltula on the north wall of it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #016
text: At nighttime in the past, a Gold Skulltula sits on the ladder of the watchtower south of the Death Mountain Trail entrance in Kakariko Village, and it can be killed with two shots from the Slingshot.

evidence.quote:
South of Death Mountain Trail's entrance sits a watchtower. There's 
 a Gold Skulltula sitting on the ladder of the tower. Kill it with two shots 
 from the Slingshot and climb up the ladder to retrieve the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #017
text: In Kakariko Graveyard at nighttime in the past, dropping bugs onto a light plot of dirt causes a Gold Skulltula to pop out.

evidence.quote:
In the graveyard is a light plot of dirt. Drop bugs onto it and a
 Gold Skulltula will pop out.

subject: Gold Skulltula #018
text: In the past on Death Mountain Trail, destroying the boulder near the Goron City entrance reveals a patch of dirt where dropping bugs makes a Gold Skulltula pop out.

evidence.quote:
Above the boulder, near the entrance to Goron City, is a bomb flower. Pick a 
 bomb from it and throw it down to the boulder to destroy it and open Dodongo's 
 Cavern. It'll also reveal a patch of dirt. Drop some bugs on the patch to 
 make this Skulltula pop out.

subject: Gold Skulltula #019
text: In Dodongo's Cavern in the past, blowing up a weak wall to the right past the southeastern entrance reveals a big steel door hiding a Gold Skulltula behind it.

evidence.quote:
Blow open the southeastern entrance in the main room, then head
 through. There's a weak wall to the right. Blow it up with a bomb or a Baby
 Dodongo, then open the big steel door for a Gold Skulltula behind it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #019 (Master Quest)
text: In Master Quest Dodongo's Cavern, lighting the unlit mid-air torches opens a door to the north where a Gold Skulltula is found inside one of the crates.

evidence.quote:
In the room with mid-air torches (where the spike traps used to be
 in OoT), pull the blocks under each torch, then light a Deku Stick using a lit
 torch. Light the unlit mid-air torches (now on blocks) to open a door to the
 north. Go through that, kill the enemies, then find this Skulltula inside one
 of the crates.

subject: Gold Skulltula #020
text: In Dodongo's Cavern in the past, a Gold Skulltula is located on the vine beside the Skullwalltula after climbing the lowered giant staircase.

evidence.quote:
Head to the northwest entrance (unlock the gates first), and head
 to the staircase surrounded by bomb flowers. Place a bomb in the gap of bomb
 flowers and it'll start a chain reaction when it blows up, lowering the giant
 staircase. Climb up it, then kill the Gold Skulltula on the vine beside the 
 Skullwalltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #020 (Master Quest)
text: In Master Quest Dodongo's Cavern, bombing rocks in the first Lizalfos room leads to a path overlooking the second Lizalfos room where a Gold Skulltula is waiting at the end.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the room you first fought some Lizalfos once you get the
 Bombs. You'll see a sort of "wall" of bombable rocks. Bomb some of them and
 jump to the path overlooking the second Lizalfos room. The Gold Skulltula is
 waiting at the end.

subject: Gold Skulltula #021
text: In Dodongo's Cavern in the past, a Gold Skulltula is found behind a breakable wall past the right entrance inside the giant Dodongo head.

evidence.quote:
Head inside the giant Dodongo head, then head to the right
 entrance. Past the walls is a breakable wall. Plant a bomb by it then head 
 through the door behind it. Defeat the Armos (optional, but it helps) and kill
 this Gold Skulltula here.

subject: Gold Skulltula #021 (Master Quest)
text: In Master Quest Dodongo's Cavern, unlocking the door in the Poe-filled room leads to a room where a Gold Skulltula is positioned high in a corner within reach of the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
In the Poe-filled room, there's a locked door to the north. To open 
 it, place a bomb/bomb flower underneath the nearby bomb flower on the wall.
 This will cause a chain reaction with the other bomb flowers and activate a
 switch to open the door. Inside, kill all the enemies, then find the Gold 
 Skulltula high in a corner so you can Boomerang it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #022
text: On Death Mountain Trail at nighttime in the past, bombing a discolored wall near the exit to Kakariko Village reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Near the exit to Kakariko Village is a discolored wall. Bomb it,
 kill the Gold Skulltula, then climb up the normal wall to collect the token.

subject: boulder maze small chests
text: In Goron City, the boulder maze room on the top level contains two small chests with a Purple Rupee in each.

evidence.quote:
On the top level, there's a room filled with boulders. Blast the
 brown boulders with Bombs and try to get through this maze to find a Gossip 
 Stone, two small chests with a Purple Rupee in each, and a crate with this 
 Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #023
text: In Goron City in the past, a Gold Skulltula is hidden inside a crate in the boulder maze on the top level.

evidence.quote:
On the top level, there's a room filled with boulders. Blast the
 brown boulders with Bombs and try to get through this maze to find a Gossip 
 Stone, two small chests with a Purple Rupee in each, and a crate with this 
 Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #024
text: In Death Mountain Crater in the past, breaking the crate right upon entering from the summit entrance releases a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you enter the crater from the summit entrance, break the
 crate to release this Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #025
text: In Zora's River in the past, rolling into the first tree seen when entering from Hyrule Field knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The first tree you see when you enter the River from Hyrule Field
 hides a Gold Skulltula. Roll into the tree to knock it down.

subject: Gold Skulltula #026
text: At nighttime in the past, a Gold Skulltula is found on the ladder near the waterfall at the end of Zora's River.

evidence.quote:
At the end
 where the waterfall is, drop down to where the ladder is and you'll find a 
 Gold Skulltula on it. Kill it with the slingshot then climb up the ladder to
 retrieve the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #027
text: At nighttime in the past, a Gold Skulltula is located on one of the pillars on the far left island in Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote:
Head to the far left island with pillars and find this Skulltula on
 one of those pillars.

subject: Gold Skulltula #028
text: In Lake Hylia in the past, dropping bugs on the plot of dirt right by the Lakeside Laboratory causes a Gold Skulltula to pop out.

evidence.quote:
Right by the Lakeside Laboratory is a plot of dirt. Drop some bugs
 on it and a Gold Skulltula will pop out.

subject: Gold Skulltula #029
text: In Zora's Fountain in the past, rolling into the tree on the island behind Jabu Jabu knocks a Gold Skulltula off its branches.

evidence.quote:
Behind Jabu Jabu is an island. Roll into the tree on the island to
 knock this Gold Skulltula off its branches.

subject: Gold Skulltula #030
text: In Jabu-Jabu's Belly in the past, a Gold Skulltula is found on the vines near the opening after falling down the hole after Princess Ruto.

evidence.quote:
After falling down the hole after Princess Ruto, head toward the
 next opening and you'll find this Gold Skulltula on the vines. Kill it with 
 the slingshot, then hit the switch in the gap to raise the water level so you 
 can reach the vines to collect the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #030 (Master Quest)
text: In Master Quest Jabu-Jabu's Belly, blowing up rocks on the wall in the northwestern room off the crossroads reveals a Gold Skulltula whose token can be retrieved with the Boomerang while atop a water jet.

evidence.quote:
In the crossroads room, take the northwestern room when it's open.
 There are Tailpasarans and Shaboms here, along with a Skullwalltula hidden in
 a rock. Kill them all, then look around the walls for some rocks. Place a 
 Bombchu underneath them to blow them up and the Gold Skulltula hiding inside.
 To get the token, step on the switch to make a water jet rise where you're
 standing. At this point, use the Boomerang to grab the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #031
text: In Jabu-Jabu's Belly in the past, dropping down the hole where the green tentacle was located leads to a high ledge with a Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote:
After clearing the hallway room of all the tentacles, head back to
 the room filled with holes. Head down the hole the green tentacle used to be 
 at to drop down to the room where you first picked up Ruto, except on a higher 
 ledge. The Gold Skulltula is on the wall here.
